name: slow-boot-probe
description: Structured log, probe of the slow cold start (GitHub issue #6, experiments/2026-11-24-slow-boot/NOTES.md): event lv_first, once per start, at the first run of the live-view struct refresh 0x7E6ECCAF, before peaking's latch T_A (whose T_R jumps to peaking-mf's T_MF in segment 2). arg0 = the word 0x7ECB0B84 of T_MF, arg1 = the word 0x7F033B74 of segment 3's constructor table, both read through the uncached alias: they tell whether the copies of segments 2 and 3 have reached them. The peaking hook 0x7E6ECF91 jumps to T_LV (segment 1, free part of lss-core's area), which jumps on to T_A; a flag at PST+104 (0x7E4FD0A8, cleared at every start by log-menu-3's T_BOOT). Event start_kind: segment 3's last constructor entry points at T_PW (segment 2), which logs the power-on factor, the wake reason and the quick start's state after the segment copies, then jumps to log-menu-3's T_CTOR (seg_loaded follows). Needs the specs of data/builds/peaking-mf.json before it. It puts the build id 3bb92179960f6978 of data/logdict/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only.
_ram: 1 byte at 0x7E4FD0A8 (uncached alias 0xBE4FD0A8, PST+104) in the log's state block, cleared at every start by log-menu-3's T_BOOT

ops._note: new code, segment 1 (free part of lss-core's area): T_LV (55 B)
new code, segment 2 (movie-ab's run, history): T_PW (42 B)
peaking hook at the end of the live-view struct refresh: `jmp T_A` -> `jmp T_LV` (T_LV logs lv_first once per start, then jumps to T_A)
segment 3's last constructor entry: log-menu-3's T_CTOR -> T_PW (logs start_kind, then jumps to T_CTOR)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 afe27672 -> 3bb92179 (data/logdict/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 d672fc95 -> 960f6978 (data/logdict/events.json)
